## Checklist

- [ ] Linked issue: `Closes #`
- [ ] Code and docs are commented and written in English
- [ ] New behaviour has tests; a bug fix has a test that reproduces it
- [ ] `docs/` is updated if the change affects schema, Elastic usage or setup
- [ ] No secrets or `.env` files included
